articles.summary: We are proud to announce our 2025 Core Values Award winners and runners-up. Each honoree was among hundreds of nominations submitted by fellow employees and colleagues. Read about each winner and runner-up and how they embody each Core Value. Actively C.A.R.E. Teamwork Innovative Spirit Service Attitude Do the Right Thing
articles.title: H&P Announces 2025 Core Value Award Honorees
